memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: "That they all may be one, as You, Father, are in Me, and I in You; that they also may be one in Us." — John 17:21

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
The proverb "A solitary tree does not make a grove" carries an eternal spiritual law. In nature, a single tree is easily vulnerable to every passing storm and the scorching heat of the sun. However, when trees stand together, their roots intertwine beneath the soil to create a "grove." This grove becomes a powerful sanctuary that protects and nurtures everything within it.
​To enter the divine unity that Jesus Christ prayed for, we must confront two things that cause division: Ego and Hyper-Individuality. Ego is the wall we build to project ourselves as superior or separate from others. Hyper-individuality is the illusion of the self that makes us believe we can survive entirely on our own.
​True spiritual power lies in Interdependence. When we dismantle selfish ego, we do not lose ourselves; rather, we remove the barriers that prevent us from becoming part of a greater whole. Just as a branch cannot bear fruit by itself, we find our true identity only when we connect with the community of Christ. When we consent to lose the selfish "I," we inherit the magnificent power of "We."

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: He who cannot live in fellowship with his brother cannot live in fellowship with God." — Dietrich Bonhoeffer

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, I thank You for the beauty of Your Church and the power found in unity. Forgive me for the times my pride built walls instead of bridges. Just as You are one with the Father, help me to lay down my ego so that I may truly be one with my brothers and sisters. May our united lives reflect Your love to the world. Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: A tree standing alone can be easily uprooted, but a grove can withstand any hurricane. Today, find a way to support the growth of others without expecting anything in return. When you help create a grove that strengthens others, your own foundation is secured.
